explanation: No match found. `puncturedDiscPow` is defined in this library (line 190 of the same file): it is the continuous map z ↦ z^e from the punctured unit disc to itself, written as a map between subtypes. The theorem says that every fiber of this map has exactly e points. Mathlib has no such map. The closest Mathlib facts are about counting nth roots in ℂ: `IsPrimitiveRoot.card_nthRootsFinset_of_pow_eq`, `IsAlgClosed.exists_pow_nat_eq` and `Polynomial.mem_nthRootsFinset`. To get the theorem from them, you first have to prove that the fiber, seen inside ℂ, equals `nthRootsFinset e w`, which requires showing that the punctured disc is closed under taking e-th roots. That takes a several-line argument, not routine glue, so this is not a special case of a single Mathlib declaration.
